== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Out Of Commission (Japanese)|Out Of Commission]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67688 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(5, 5, 453, 623)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>3380114e694420158c3e1af4c3ff5a8a2685da084a71d1a26812cf6f86a78b6a</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
